REBOUNDOPS / LOCAL DEVELOPER PREVIEW

Recovery workflow

Turn experience into a direction to test and a bounded seven-day plan.

On this pageDescribe your starting pointReview what your claims supportChoose a hypothesisTry a manageable next action

Describe your starting point

Enter your experience, priorities, practical constraints and available weekly time. Start small: a few specific achievements are more useful than a long list of general skills. Recovery supports up to 15 achievement claims, three source excerpts and three job targets per session.

Review what your claims support

In the Angular app, attach exact quotations from pasted résumé or project-note excerpts. Confirm, reject or leave each achievement unverified. A quotation identifies a source; your confirmation records your review, not independent verification.

Correcting a claim records its history, resets confirmation and revokes dependent requirement links. Only confirmed claims can support manual job-requirement links or enter optional recovery AI review.

Read the evidence rules ↗ and job-requirement guide ↗ for exact behavior.

Choose a hypothesis

  • Return: explore similar work to what you have done.
  • Shift: explore a different kind of work using transferable evidence.
  • Bridge: explore a stepping-stone role or a smaller deliverable.

Review the assumptions and unknowns before choosing. These routes describe possibilities to test, not employability scores or hiring predictions.

Try a manageable next action

Generate a seven-day plan bounded by your stated available hours. Complete an action, record what happened and revisit the direction if the evidence changes. You choose which opportunities to pursue and submit applications yourself. Use Make a step specific to your evidence gap to replace a template with a reviewed experiment; allocated minutes remain unchanged and the task’s completion mark resets.

The integrated workspace supports save, resume, JSON backups and reviewed transfers into CV/profile/preferences forms. Use Open full recovery for detailed evidence, requirement review and check-ins in the same session.
